title: Align ORM Metadata with Alembic 0020 Season Constraint
blocker: The requested branch must start from latest master and change only ORM metadata, but latest master does not contain the already-executed 0020 migration. Isolated migration 0001 to 0020 and Alembic head/check validation are impossible without carrying that existing migration artifact or prior branch history into this task.
recommended_resolution: Explicitly authorize copying the unchanged existing 0020 migration file from ec88789 into this branch, then implement only the SeasonORM UniqueConstraint and complete isolated validation.
